# Multiplexer argv per verb, after `<mux> -S <socket>`: one call per line, tokens joined by one space.
# Written by hand from scripts/MuxAgents.ps1 at a96b866 (lines per call below), adapted only where the spec
# changed: a spawn pane runs `<hc> attach <address>`; the sidebar still runs `<exe> watch`. The scoped launcher
# runs only through hc, and the tagged-pane list frames each row with a fresh per-call marker.
# Placeholders: <marker> the 32-hex marker, <state> the state root, <cwd> the caller's cwd, <exe> the binary,
# <id> the new agent's id, <hc> the resolved core binary, <buffer> a read's private buffer (mux-agents-<32 hex>).
# `-e MUX_AGENTS_STATE=<state>` is the Unix sidebar environment; attachment panes have none.
# :370 caller probe; :539 tagged-pane list; :1188 gone probe of agent %8 (committed, no notice, not listed).
# 0.2.2: the tagged-pane list also reads #{pane_dead}, so reap can close a pane remain-on-exit kept.
# 0.2.3 (#48): agents are found by their pane and the exact command it started, never by their tags. The pane list
# reads every pane with #{pane_start_command}, every field framed by the marker; every action on an agent's pane is
# one `if-shell -F` that holds only while the pane is still that launch.
# 0.2.4 (#59): the side bar is `@mux-agents-sidebar-percent` (5) of its window, at least `@mux-agents-sidebar-min` (30)
# columns, both read in the window probe and the layout; `\n` and `\r` stand for those LF and CR bytes.
# 0.2.6 (#74): the default side bar is 20% of its window, at least 40 columns
# 0.3.0 (#104): spawn tags, title and allow-set-title are separate bound calls; failed tagging kills hc once
# (asserted separately), then cleans the guarded view. The original rmux refusal is preserved.

[spawn -Client claude -Task hi]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
# 0.2.3 (#48): the caller's pane carries no agent tag and is no agent record's pane
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
# 0.2.1: no -Split or -Tab, so the session's placement is read, before the spawn lock
-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-placement
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
-N new-window -d -P -F #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_start_command} -t $3: -n hi -c <cwd> <hc> attach t1
-N if-shell -F -t %12 '#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}' 'set-option -p -t %12 @agent-id <id> ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-name hi ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-parent %1 ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-context brief:human'
-N if-shell -F -t %12 '#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}' 'select-pane -T hi -t %12'
-N if-shell -F -t %12 '#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}' 'set-option -p -t %12 allow-set-title off'
-N display-message -p -t %12 '#{pane_id}|#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}'
# 0.2.1: committed and the spawn lock released, the side bar is found or opened under the sidebar lock
# 0.3.0 (#103): the bar is its window's: the record is a window option of that window, the label is looked for in
# that window, and the split, its width probe and the record target the window; the lock stays the session's
-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-sidebar
# 0.3.0 (#103 QA): under the lock, the view's window is marked as one that held a view
-N set-option -w -t @7 @mux-agents-viewed 1
# 0.2.3 (#47): no recorded bar, and no labelled pane anywhere in the session
# 0.3.0 (#103): first, under the lock, the 0.2.x session record: proven, it moves to its bar's window; else
# it refuses while the session holds a label, or is unset. Nothing recorded here: nothing moves
-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-sidebar-id
# 0.3.0 (#103): spawn keeps the bar of the new view's window (@7, where new-window put the agent)
-N show-options -wqv -t @7 @mux-agents-sidebar-id
-N list-panes -t @7 -F #{pane_id}|#{==:#{@agent-role},sidebar}
# 0.3.0 (#103 QA): before a split, the window's panes with the bar's mark; none here is ours
-N list-panes -t @7 -F #{pane_pid}|#{pane_id}|#{@mux-agents-bar}
# 0.2.3 (S1): the window's width sizes the bar (0.2.4: max(30, width * 5 / 100)); a full-height split at the right edge
-N display-message -p -t @7 #{window_width}|#{s/[|\n\r]/x/:@mux-agents-sidebar-min}|#{s/[|\n\r]/x/:@mux-agents-sidebar-percent}
-N split-window -d -f -h -P -F #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_pid} -t @7 -e MUX_AGENTS_STATE=<state> -l 40 <exe> watch
# 0.3.0 (#103 QA): the new pane carries the bar's mark, its own pid, from its split on
-N if-shell -F -t %13 #{==:#{pane_pid},113} 'set-option -p -t %13 @mux-agents-bar 113'
-N if-shell -F -t %13 #{&&:#{==:#{pane_dead},0},#{==:#{pane_pid},113}} 'set-option -p -t %13 @agent-role sidebar'
-N display-message -p -t %13 #{@agent-role}
# 0.2.3 (#47): pid 113 is this binary `watch`, so the bar is recorded as <pane> <pid> <start>
-N set-option -w -t @7 @mux-agents-sidebar-id '%13 113 1130'
# rmux ignores -l, so the bar is sized again
-N if-shell -F -t %13 #{&&:#{==:#{pane_dead},0},#{==:#{pane_pid},113}} 'resize-pane -t %13 -x 40'
# 0.2.3 (#47): proven last, so a pane replaced during open is never reported as the bar
-N display-message -p -t %13 #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_dead}|#{pane_pid}

[spawn -Client copilot -Task hi -Split v -Name helper]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
-N split-window -v -d -P -F #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_start_command} -t %1 -c <cwd> <hc> attach t1
-N if-shell -F -t %12 '#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}' 'set-option -p -t %12 @agent-id <id> ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-name helper ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-parent %1 ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-context brief:human'
-N if-shell -F -t %12 '#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}' 'select-pane -T helper -t %12'
-N if-shell -F -t %12 '#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}' 'set-option -p -t %12 allow-set-title off'
-N display-message -p -t %12 '#{pane_id}|#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}'
-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-sidebar
# 0.3.0 (#103 QA): under the lock, the view's window is marked as one that held a view
-N set-option -w -t @7 @mux-agents-viewed 1
# 0.2.3 (#47): no recorded bar, and no labelled pane anywhere in the session
-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-sidebar-id
-N show-options -wqv -t @7 @mux-agents-sidebar-id
-N list-panes -t @7 -F #{pane_id}|#{==:#{@agent-role},sidebar}
# 0.3.0 (#103 QA): before a split, the window's panes with the bar's mark; none here is ours
-N list-panes -t @7 -F #{pane_pid}|#{pane_id}|#{@mux-agents-bar}
# 0.2.3 (S1): the window's width sizes the bar (0.2.4: max(30, width * 5 / 100)); a full-height split at the right edge
-N display-message -p -t @7 #{window_width}|#{s/[|\n\r]/x/:@mux-agents-sidebar-min}|#{s/[|\n\r]/x/:@mux-agents-sidebar-percent}
-N split-window -d -f -h -P -F #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_pid} -t @7 -e MUX_AGENTS_STATE=<state> -l 40 <exe> watch
# 0.3.0 (#103 QA): the new pane carries the bar's mark, its own pid, from its split on
-N if-shell -F -t %13 #{==:#{pane_pid},113} 'set-option -p -t %13 @mux-agents-bar 113'
-N if-shell -F -t %13 #{&&:#{==:#{pane_dead},0},#{==:#{pane_pid},113}} 'set-option -p -t %13 @agent-role sidebar'
-N display-message -p -t %13 #{@agent-role}
# 0.2.3 (#47): pid 113 is this binary `watch`, so the bar is recorded as <pane> <pid> <start>
-N set-option -w -t @7 @mux-agents-sidebar-id '%13 113 1130'
# rmux ignores -l, so the bar is sized again
-N if-shell -F -t %13 #{&&:#{==:#{pane_dead},0},#{==:#{pane_pid},113}} 'resize-pane -t %13 -x 40'
# 0.2.3 (#47): proven last, so a pane replaced during open is never reported as the bar
-N display-message -p -t %13 #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_dead}|#{pane_pid}

[spawn -Client claude -Task hi, placement h, side bar off]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-placement
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
# the stored placement: a split beside the caller, as -Split h
-N split-window -h -d -P -F #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_start_command} -t %1 -c <cwd> <hc> attach t1
-N if-shell -F -t %12 '#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}' 'set-option -p -t %12 @agent-id <id> ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-name hi ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-parent %1 ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-context brief:human'
-N if-shell -F -t %12 '#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}' 'select-pane -T hi -t %12'
-N if-shell -F -t %12 '#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}' 'set-option -p -t %12 allow-set-title off'
-N display-message -p -t %12 '#{pane_id}|#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}'
# off after sidebar -Close: read, nothing opened
-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-sidebar

[spawn -Client claude -Task hi, tagging fails]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-placement
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
-N new-window -d -P -F #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_start_command} -t $3: -n hi -c <cwd> <hc> attach t1
-N if-shell -F -t %12 '#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}' 'set-option -p -t %12 @agent-id <id> ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-name hi ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-parent %1 ; set-option -p -t %12 @agent-context brief:human'
-N if-shell -F -t %12 '#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach t1}' 'kill-pane -t %12'
-N display-message -p -t %12 #{pane_id}|#{@agent-id}

[spawn -Client claude -TaskFile t.md -BriefFile b.md, from a Claude agent]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
# :950, 954 (C2: the pane's mode line); 0.2.2: -J joins a wrapped footer
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pane_height}
-N capture-pane -p -J -t %1

# placement is new in 0.2.1 (no reference line): a session user option on the caller's session.
[placement]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-placement

[placement h]

-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
-N set-option -t $3 @mux-agents-placement h

[list]

-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>

[list -All]

[focus worker]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
# The window and pane are selected only while %9 is still its live hc attachment, then read back:
# active in the active window, live and that attachment
-N if-shell -F -t %9 '#{&&:#{==:#{pane_dead},0},#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach taaaaaaaaaaaa}}' 'select-window -t %9 ; select-pane -t %9'
-N display-message -p -t %9 '#{pane_id}|#{window_active}|#{pane_active}|#{&&:#{==:#{pane_dead},0},#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach taaaaaaaaaaaa}}'
# 0.3.0 (#103): then, under the sidebar lock, the bar of the focused view's window; here the session's bar is off
-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-sidebar

[send worker -Body hi]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
# :1316; 0.2.3 (#48): a live pane of this session; the mailbox is the running agent's there, never a tag's
-N display-message -p -t %9 #{pane_id}|#{session_id}

[read]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>

[read worker -Lines 5]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
-N if-shell -F -t %9 '#{&&:#{==:#{pane_dead},0},#{==:#{pane_start_command},hc attach taaaaaaaaaaaa}}' 'capture-pane -J -t %9 -b <buffer> -S -5'
-N show-buffer -b <buffer>
-N delete-buffer -b <buffer>

[stop worker]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}

[status -BodyFile s.md, from a Claude agent]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
# 0.2.3 (#48): the caller's pane is a running agent's own pane

-N set-option -u -t $3 @mux-agents-sidebar
# :1526

-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-sidebar-id
-N show-options -wqv -t @1 @mux-agents-sidebar-id

[sidebar, -l refused]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>

# 0.3.0 (#103 QA): before a split, the window's panes with the bar's mark; none here is ours
-N list-panes -t @1 -F #{pane_pid}|#{pane_id}|#{@mux-agents-bar}
-N display-message -p -t @1 #{window_width}|#{s/[|\n\r]/x/:@mux-agents-sidebar-min}|#{s/[|\n\r]/x/:@mux-agents-sidebar-percent}
-N split-window -d -f -h -P -F #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_pid} -t @1 -e MUX_AGENTS_STATE=<state> -l 40 <exe> watch
# :1580
-N split-window -d -f -h -P -F #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_pid} -t @1 -e MUX_AGENTS_STATE=<state> <exe> watch
# 0.3.0 (#103 QA): the new pane carries the bar's mark, its own pid, from its split on
-N if-shell -F -t %13 #{==:#{pane_pid},113} 'set-option -p -t %13 @mux-agents-bar 113'

# 0.2.3 (#47): pid 113 is this binary `watch`, so the bar is recorded as <pane> <pid> <start>
-N set-option -w -t @1 @mux-agents-sidebar-id '%13 113 1130'
# the multiplexer chose the width, so the resize sets it
-N if-shell -F -t %13 #{&&:#{==:#{pane_dead},0},#{==:#{pane_pid},113}} 'resize-pane -t %13 -x 40'
# 0.2.3 (#47): proven last, so a pane replaced during open is never reported as the bar
-N display-message -p -t %13 #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_dead}|#{pane_pid}

[sidebar -Close]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
# 0.2.1: off first, inside the sidebar lock, so no spawn reopens the bar
-N set-option -t $3 @mux-agents-sidebar off
# 0.2.3 (#47): the recorded bar, proven by one read (alive, the recorded pid) and its process (alive, the same start,
# still this binary `watch`); a label is never trusted
-N show-options -qv -t $3 @mux-agents-sidebar-id
# 0.3.0 (#103): every window's bar: the window ids only (a window list's option fields fall back to the session's
# value), then each window's own record, proven, killed and cleared
-N list-windows -t $3 -F #{window_id}
-N show-options -wqv -t @1 @mux-agents-sidebar-id
-N display-message -p -t %13 #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_dead}|#{pane_pid}
# :1555; 0.2.3 (#47): killed only while still alive with that pid, checked by the server in the same command; the
# pane is read again and must be gone, then the record is cleared
-N if-shell -F -t %13 #{&&:#{==:#{pane_dead},0},#{==:#{pane_pid},113}} 'kill-pane -t %13'
-N display-message -p -t %13 #{pane_id}|#{pane_pid}
-N set-option -wu -t @1 @mux-agents-sidebar-id

[watch, one frame]
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pid}|#{pane_pid}|#{session_id}|#{window_id}|#{@agent-id}
# :1482; S2 (#37): the probe also reads the pane's size, so each frame is laid out at its actual width and height
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pane_id}|#{@agent-role}|#{pane_width}|#{pane_height}
# 0.2.3 (S1, #47): only the watch the record names, by its own pane and process, reads its window and repairs it;
# the record is proven like any other: its pane runs this watch's pid, and the pid is this watch with that start
-N show-options -wqv -t @1 @mux-agents-sidebar-id
-N display-message -p -t %1 #{pane_id}|#{window_id}|#{pane_dead}|#{pane_pid}
# 0.3.0 (#103 QA): a bar whose window has not held a view yet reads the window's viewed mark
-N show-options -wqv -t @1 @mux-agents-viewed
-N list-panes -t %1 -F #{pane_id}|#{pane_active}|#{pane_at_right}|#{pane_at_top}|#{pane_at_bottom}|#{pane_width}|#{window_width}|#{pane_left}|#{pane_top}|#{window_zoomed_flag}|#{s/[|\n\r]/x/:@mux-agents-sidebar-min}|#{s/[|\n\r]/x/:@mux-agents-sidebar-percent}
-N list-panes -s -t $3 -F <marker>#{pane_id}<marker>#{window_id}<marker>#{pane_pid}<marker>#{pane_dead}<marker>#{pane_start_command}<marker>#{@agent-id}<marker>#{@agent-name}<marker>
# 0.3.0 (#82): which pane the session shows to an attached client, so a done agent the person looked at is marked seen
-N display-message -p -t $3 #{pane_id}|#{session_attached}
